editorial_thesis: Practical agent leverage is moving into the seams: observe real behavior, route by task economics, ship governed remediation, and compose connected services around explicit confirmation.

topic_groups.title: Agent Observability
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A coverage gap after repeated security and control-plane rounds; fresh tracing capability offers an immediately testable production practice.

sources.title: Always-on tracing for production and preview traffic
sources.why_selected: Scoped live tracing with path rules and bounded retention is a concrete way to capture unreproducible agent failures.
sources.usefulness: Use request IDs and sampled spans to make Buildn artifact workflows diagnosable.

topic_groups.title: Model Routing Economics
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Recent coverage emphasized models and standards; today’s signal is operational—price reduction plus a new modality changes routing decisions.

sources.title: GPT-5.6 Sol is now 50 percent off a lower price
sources.why_selected: The model ID is unchanged while input and output pricing fall, enabling a low-friction cost trial.
sources.usefulness: Benchmark cost per accepted artifact before changing defaults.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Experimental now available on AI Gateway
sources.why_selected: A new image-capable experimental route supports screenshot and chart triage.
sources.usefulness: Prototype visual QA with a fallback model.

topic_groups.title: Open Source Security Operations
topic_groups.selection_rationale: Moves beyond recently covered security governance into the under-covered remediation and maintainer-workflow layer.

sources.title: Patch the Planet: A Daybreak Initiative to Support Open-Source Maintainers
sources.why_selected: The program pairs AI-assisted discovery with validation, patching, testing, disclosure, and maintainer control.
sources.usefulness: Reusable remediation-packet pattern for client dependencies and agent-generated code.

topic_groups.title: Connected Product Workflows
topic_groups.selection_rationale: A deliberate product/design lane after several infrastructure-heavy days; connected-app expansion is a signal about completion-oriented assistant UX.

sources.title: Now you can connect even more of your favorite apps and services to Gemini
sources.why_selected: Google is extending Gemini across productivity, commerce, local services, music, home, and health.
sources.usefulness: Use intent-to-confirmation as the design unit for Buildn/client workflows.
